test_title: PYST 15: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the following sentence with its ANTONYM.

The moment our English Instructor said the final paper is going to be __tough__, it was music to my ears!
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"tough"** means something that is difficult to accomplish, endure, or deal with. (कठिन)

 
 
• **Example: **The exam was** tough,** and many students found it challenging to complete on time.
 
 
 
• **"Resolvable"** means something that can be solved or settled. (सुलझने योग्य)
 
 
• **Example: **Most conflicts are** resolvable** if both parties are willing to communicate effectively.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'tough'** is **'resolvable'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Durable** (टिकाऊ): Able to withstand wear, pressure, or damage; hard-wearing.

 
 
• **Example:** The furniture is made from durable materials that will last for years.
 
 
 
• **Unpredictable** (अनिश्चित): Not able to be predicted; changeable.
 
 
• **Example:** The weather in the mountains can be very unpredictable.
 
 
 
• **Peculiar** (अजीब): Strange or odd; unusual.
 
 
• **Example:** She has a peculiar habit of talking to herself.
